title: hadid ribbons · five interlocking parametric sweeps
concept: 5 interlocking parametric ribbon surfaces (CatmullRomCurve3 + TubeGeometry) sweeping through space at different counter-rotating speeds. Dominant form = negative space between ribbons. Channel Zaha Hadid continuous-surface architecture. Palette: platinum #d4d0c8 on void-black #060606, one dull-gold accent ribbon #8a6a20.
